entities.summary: Muhammad-Ali Abdur-Rahkman is an American-Saudi Arabian professional basketball player for Treviso Basket of the Lega Basket Serie A (LBA). He played college basketball for the Michigan Wolverines. Abdur-Rahkman played high school basketball for Allentown Central Catholic High School in his hometown of Allentown, Pennsylvania, where he was a four-time Pennsylvania Interscholastic Athletic Association (PIAA) Class AAA All-State selection.
